body:
who notices someone's nail polish in a music video and files it away for a whole YEAR? swifties, that's who. and they were RIGHT 😭

back in march 2018, the 'delicate' video showed taylor's nails in this soft pastel color story that made zero sense for the dark reputation era. it looked like a mistake. it was not a mistake.

more than a year later 'ME!' dropped and launched the entire pastel lover world — the exact palette pictured here — and taylor confirmed those 'delicate' nail colors had been an easter egg for the next era the whole time. she planted it thirteen months early and just... waited.

this is what The Decode is for: take one tiny clue and follow the thread all the way to the payoff it was pointing at. open it and start with this one.

(pictured: the lover act of the eras tour, minneapolis 2023 — photo by michael hicks, cc by 2.0, via wikimedia commons)
